class.name: ChorusMessage
class.description: A text message with a durable identity in conversation history. Use [method create] to prepare history for [method GodotChorus.import_conversation_history]. Exported resources are copies: editing them does not change stored history; use [method GodotChorus.edit_message] or import the changed history.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates a history message with the supplied identity, role and text. Creation does not validate or import the message. History import requires nonnegative IDs that are unique within the supplied history.

members.member: Durable message identity, not an array index. Import requires a nonnegative value unique within the history. The default value of [code]-1[/code] is not a valid imported identity.
Speaker of this message. See [enum ChorusRole.Value].
Literal message text. The provider applies the chat template when preparing a sessioned request.
